## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into. For example: "I'm
always frustrated when [...]". Focusing on the problem (rather than jumping
straight to a solution) makes it easier to discuss the best way to address
it.

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. Be as specific as you can — mock-ups,
example screens from other apps, or sample API requests/responses are all
useful.

## Alternatives considered

Have you thought of any other ways to solve this problem, or workarounds
you're currently using? Why do they fall short?

## Additional context

Add any other context, links, or screenshots about the feature request here.
